title: Cashier processing
intro: Every confirmed work order enters the cashier's Pending queue. The order cannot be dispatched to the workshop until a cashier has processed it here. Note that the gate is opened by the act of processing, not by payment: an order confirmed without payment is free to proceed.

steps.title: Open the Pending queue
steps.body: Select Cashier in the sidebar (1). The Pending tab opens by default and lists every confirmed order awaiting processing. Select the customer's order (2). No action buttons are displayed until an order is selected.

steps.title: Select a processing method
steps.body: Two options become available. Confirm without payment (1) opens the dispatch gate with no money taken and does not require an open register. Proceed to payment (2) records a payment and does require an open register. Either option opens the gate.

steps.title: Confirm the processing
steps.body: Verify that the order shown is correct, then confirm (1). The order leaves the Pending queue and becomes available for dispatch, as described in chapter [[ref:03-dispatch.new-orders-tab]].
